g.text: Served from CDN • Minimal S3 load
But requests span the entire globe
No database = No bottleneck. Just a massive key-value store where every key is a unique hash.
The elegant simplicity of hash-addressed storage enables infinite horizontal scaling.
• Simple S3 bucket design scales effortlessly to billions of objects
• Fastly CDN achieves 94%+ cache hits globally
• S3 Intelligent-Tiering moves objects between access tiers automatically
